store.0: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been researching both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines. He recently ordered an espresso machine with regular shipping, expecting an estimated delivery time of 11 business days. However, the delivery is delayed, and he is now considering alternative options for his gathering. Michael is concerned about the process of filing a claim with the carrier if the package is confirmed lost or damaged during transit. He wants to know if the company would handle the claim on his behalf or if he would need to do it himself. Michael is also interested in knowing if there is a return and exchange policy in place for delayed or lost shipments. He is requesting an update on the shipping status and a realistic timeline for delivery.
store.1: The espresso machine has a significant dent on the right side, sharp edges, crushed corners on the outer box, a popped-out drip tray, and a bent steam wand. Michael is seeking assistance with a hassle-free replacement process and is willing to provide proof of damage in the form of photos and potentially a video. He is concerned about the past experiences with other companies and wants to avoid similar issues. Michael also wants to know if the warranty covers shipping-related damage and if it falls under the no-hassle return policy. He is hopeful for a positive resolution and is willing to provide additional information or assistance as needed.
